We need number of aromatic carbons in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. Need to get NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons count. Use carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR, then count aromatic carbon signals (typically 120-150 ppm). Could also use HSQC but maybe not needed.

We need to call carbon_nmr_spectra (no args).
